I've replied to Tobias in your DM. The deadline is 9 August. That's the cutoff he gave me himself in this DM on 14 Oct, for the Marrow Agrisupply paperwork on the Moorland renewal.

He didn't give a year, and 9 August 2026 has already passed (today is 21 Oct 2026). So I said it's probably 9 August 2027 and asked him to confirm.

There's no other deadline for this in #central-team or in the public files, and the share has no Marrow Agrisupply contract or renewal files I could check it against.
